verification: Values written from general knowledge of the cited documents. The standards themselves are paid documents and were not opened; verify against the source before relying on them. No legal interpretation is given.

pallets.name: EUR / EPAL pallet
pallets.source: EPAL pallet specification (epal-pallets.org); ISO 6780 lists 1200 x 800 mm

pallets.name: EUR 2 / EPAL 2 pallet
pallets.source: ISO 6780 lists 1200 x 1000 mm; height not confirmed

pallets.name: GMA pallet (North America)
pallets.source: 48 x 40 in; ISO 6780 lists 1219 x 1016 mm; height varies by build

containers_and_boxes.name: Modular plastic container 600 x 400
containers_and_boxes.source: Modular footprint 600 x 400 mm used by ISO 3394 (distribution packaging); heights vary by model

containers_and_boxes.name: Modular plastic container 400 x 300
containers_and_boxes.source: ISO 3394 modular footprint; heights vary by model

containers_and_boxes.name: Standard cardboard box
containers_and_boxes.source: FEFCO/ESBO code system defines box styles (e.g. 0201), not fixed sizes. No standard size table was found; set per project.

work_table_heights.source: ISO 14738 (anthropometric requirements for machinery workstations) and EN 527-1 (office work tables) set requirements, not a single value. No value is stated here.
